purpose: Turn the six Noonline SLA work packages into handoff-ready activation cards. Each card specifies the minimum record, release test, stop decision and close-out needed before a concept can enter a reversible pilot, professional deepening or bounded expansion.
claim_boundary: This contract is not an appointment, budget, procurement route, land right, permit, construction programme, operating commitment or approval. Every named role is a capability that a future authorised party must evidence before the relevant phase can advance.

release_checks.required_record: authorised record of the selected interface, public-access condition and escalation contact
release_checks.failure_response: HOLD the affected activation; do not infer public access from a concept line or public webpage.

release_checks.required_record: walkthrough record showing the public bypass, clearway and any temporary occupation boundary
release_checks.failure_response: STOP or relocate the component if public passage is occupied, unsafe or inaccessible.

release_checks.required_record: authorised field observation of legal crossing, entry and accessible alternative where the work package depends on them
release_checks.failure_response: REROUTE or suspend the continuity claim when the alternative is unverified, unavailable or unacceptable.

release_checks.required_record: legibility check for fixed bilingual direction, symbols and unavailable-service notice
release_checks.failure_response: Do not activate a digital or AI layer when physical information cannot stand alone.

release_checks.required_record: appointed contact, service window, escalation path and stop decision record for the activation window
release_checks.failure_response: HOLD public-service or test claims until an authorised person can stop, explain and hand over the condition.

release_checks.required_record: maintainability, inspection interval, removal method and public-information fallback record
release_checks.failure_response: REMOVE or DOWNGRADE the component if it cannot be maintained or withdrawn without degrading public use.

release_checks.name_zh: 可选 AI 与数据边界
release_checks.required_record: data-use, privacy, security, appeal and AI-OFF exercise record before an AI layer is activated
release_checks.failure_response: SWITCH OFF the AI layer and retain physical and human service if any data, audit, explanation or appeal condition fails.

release_checks.required_record: dated acceptance result, evidence references, unresolved issues, next reviewer and close-out decision
release_checks.failure_response: Do not expand or represent a result as verified; retain the prior SLA state and correct or close the activation.

taskbook_function_delivery_map.public_test: A bounded test may proceed only after public bypass, human stop authority, privacy boundary and close-out record are available.
Public explanation, question and appeal remain usable without a phone, screen or AI account.
Every scenario is bounded by an evidence gate, physical fallback and stop or downgrade response.
A selected interface protects clearway, crossing and maintenance before it claims staying, service or continuity.
AI-OFF, evidence limits, appeal and stop decisions are published as a reusable method rather than hidden operational claims.

activation_cards.activation_scope: A selected Level 1 fixed-wayfinding, clearway and support-reservation interface.
activation_cards.acceptance_exercise: Walk the declared decision points with AI and mobile service unavailable; confirm legible physical guidance and no loss of the documented clearway.
activation_cards.close_out: Remove or relocate any marker that cannot remain lawful, legible and maintainable; it does not count as service support after removal.

activation_cards.activation_scope: A bounded Zhongzhiyuan research-test porch that is separated from the public path.
activation_cards.acceptance_exercise: Run a stop drill that closes the test-facing layer while preserving a legible public bypass and human explanation.
activation_cards.close_out: Suspend the test-facing layer and retain only authorised public information or a reroute when permission, buffer or safety fails.

activation_cards.activation_scope: A bounded AI Origin civic knowledge-room interface for physical interpretation, enquiry and optional AI explanation.
activation_cards.acceptance_exercise: Confirm that a visitor can enter, understand the core message, ask a question and leave without phone, screen or AI use.
activation_cards.close_out: Withdraw the interactive layer if the entry, content rights, maintenance route or human enquiry path is unavailable.

activation_cards.activation_scope: A selected Dazhongsi arrival-to-daily-service decision sequence, without asserting direct station access.
activation_cards.acceptance_exercise: Complete a documented arrival, crossing, short-stay and human-enquiry walkthrough using the legal, accessible alternative.
activation_cards.close_out: Reroute to a verified public edge or suspend the transfer-continuity claim when crossing, entry, access or responsibility fails.

activation_cards.activation_scope: A selected fixed-wayfinding and human-fallback point with a declared service window.
activation_cards.acceptance_exercise: Use the physical sign and human handover to resolve a declared failure while AI is off; record the outcome and any unavailable service.
activation_cards.close_out: Downgrade the service statement, show an authorised physical alternative or stop the point when staff, sign, rest or water provision is unavailable.

activation_cards.activation_scope: Authorised field verification, recalculation and design-iteration workflow for the affected route or node.
activation_cards.acceptance_exercise: Verify that every claimed improvement has a human verifier, timestamp, evidence reference, validity period and recomputed review record.
activation_cards.close_out: Retain or lower the Verified SLA and correct the concept record whenever evidence is missing, stale, rejected or written by an AI actor.

readiness_measures.formula: count(activated work packages with every applicable DR-GATE record complete) / count(activated work packages)
readiness_measures.reason: No work package is active at submission baseline; a missing record keeps the package on HOLD.

readiness_measures.formula: count(activated packages passing their documented AI-OFF acceptance exercise) / count(activated packages)
readiness_measures.reason: A concept diagram or AI simulation cannot establish a public-service pass.

readiness_measures.formula: count(activated packages with current dated acceptance and handover evidence) / count(activated packages)
readiness_measures.reason: No appointed operator, active service window or field evidence exists at submission baseline.
